message.content: {"rules":["The `len` bytes pointed to by `ptr` must be valid UTF-8.","`ptr` must be non-null and properly aligned, even when `len` is zero.","`ptr` must be valid for both reads and writes for `len` bytes.","The entire `len`-byte memory range starting at `ptr` must be contained within a single allocated object.","`ptr` must point to `len` consecutive properly initialized `u8` values.","For the duration of the returned mutable string's lifetime `'a`, its memory must not be read or written through any pointer not derived from the returned reference.","`len`, measured in bytes, must be no larger than `isize::MAX`.","Adding `len` bytes to `ptr` must not wrap around the address space."]}
